inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev3 donor-free TEX synthesis, dev2 native vertex/material schema synthesis, dev1 integrated mod staging, dev28 TXIF graph, dev27 scene graph, dev26 mesh graph, dev25 retail GMX evidence, native builders, extraction/research and source-only gates are inherited. dev4 adds donor-free native MOTN/ANIM creation and glTF TRS animation import.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 78/78 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Animation import currently supports one target BONE per glTF animation and LINEAR/STEP TRS channels; CUBICSPLINE and multi-bone clips remain unsupported.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary synthesized animations/models/textures remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation, remaining opaque GMX chunk semantics, and fully template-free GMX root construction remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX evidence is inherited rather than re-run from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
